notes.subject: kala bilong olgeta king
notes.rationale: ארגמן (purple) i kala bilong olgeta king — Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok bilong en.

notes.subject: ברהטים
notes.rationale: Wanpela tok we i min 'ol chanel bilong wara' o 'ol ringlet hari' — planti tanim tok i usim 'hari', tasol as bilong tok i lukim ol chanel.

notes.subject: דלת / אסור
notes.rationale: Ol hari i tanim daun (dangling) na king i holim pas — piksa bilong pas bilong klostu, em i strong long Hibru.

translation: Hed bilong yu antap long yu i olsem Karmel, na ol hari bilong hed bilong yu i olsem kala bilong olgeta king; king i holim pas long ol ringlet hari.

tokens.gloss: na ol hari i tanim daun
